message.content: {"transaction_id":"TEST-046","recognition_condition":"Control transfers only upon customer inspection approval and acceptance, which is a substantive condition per contract CONTRACT-046.","qualifying_event_date":"2026-01-02","recorded_accounting_date":"2026-01-02","eligible_quantity_by_cutoff":0,"recorded_quantity_in_2025":120,"conclusion":"Premature recognition","difference_cny":7200,"explanation":"The contract requires customer acceptance as the recognition event, which occurred on 2026-01-02, after the 2025-12-31 cut-off date.
